title: 81. How can I publish my results?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How can I publish my results.
short_answer: Open the survey, go to the 'Properties' page and select 'Publish Results' section. Here you will find the URL of the published results and will be able to choose which questions/answers/contributions you would like to publish. You can also go there directly by clicking on 'Edit Results Publication' from the 'Overview' page of your survey.
procedure: Please be sure to select something in 'Publish Results' under 'Publish', otherwise the system will not publish any results.
